O.content: No visible inscription states a substantial-change threshold, escalation rule, or routing instruction.
The endpoint markers are aligned with 2005 and 2015 and carry printed inscriptions "24.0°C" and "10.0°C", respectively.

B.text: If the workflow requires an explicit displayed or supplied substantial-change threshold before escalation, then the absence of such a threshold prevents establishing substantial-change eligibility from the chart alone; under a routine-by-default policy, retain the record in routine monitoring.
B.conditions: This depends on a routine-by-default policy, which is not supplied in the task or chart.

O.location: leftmost plotted marker aligned with x-axis tick 2005
O.content: A black marker has the adjacent printed inscription "24.0°C".

O.location: rightmost plotted marker aligned with x-axis tick 2015
O.content: A black marker has the adjacent printed inscription "10.0°C".
The title reads "Coastal Water Temperature Trend" and the vertical axis reads "Water temperature (°C)".

B.text: If the plotted markers are coastal water-temperature readings for their aligned year ticks and the adjacent °C inscriptions label those readings, then the full-period change is the 2015 reading minus the 2005 reading. If a decrease of that magnitude meets the unspecified substantial-change criterion, route it to substantial-change follow-up.
B.conditions: Applies to the displayed 2005 and 2015 endpoints. The chart does not display a numerical or qualitative threshold defining substantial change.
